fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-06-26 at approximately 21:45, it was reported that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 15,000 was withdrawn. Mathan Raman (9000000187), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. A person named Harish Murugan, associated with the number 9000000180, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The account reference SYN-ACC-100050 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A witness, Rajesh Krishnan, reachable on 9000000167, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, shopping complex, transaction record, night, screenshot, bank account, associate
